notes.title: Next Fest Demo
notes.notes: [p]In celebration of Steam Next Fest, we're granting every victorious adventurer the power to forge their own artifact card! The first four champions have conquered the crypts and earned their place in tiny crypts history with these magnificent artifacts (now waiting to be discovered in the demo):[/p][list][*][p] [b]Dean[/b] - Sun Fork[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rydog[/b] - Thunder Claw[/p][/*][*][p][b]Azlyum[/b] - Arcane Bind[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dom[/b] - Fatal Blow[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561060/7bb2abd11287a3bf08e8208144c803e31366a71f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Dare to venture into the depths and uncover what devastating powers these artifacts possess? Only the brave will learn their secrets...[/p][p][b]Brave the depths and claim your reward![/b] The first 100 adventurers to conquer the demo and share their victory screen in our discord will earn the ultimate prize - the chance to forge your own artifact card! Design a card that will become part of the game forever, for all fellow adventurers to discover and use![/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Banished the dreaded necromancy bug - enemies can no longer heal themselves with your clicks (dark magic has been contained)[/p][/*][*][p]Escape key now grants safe passage rather than instant banishment from the realm[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the hordes - fewer goblin swarms, more strategic encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Increased your starting coins from 150 to 300 (even heroes need proper funding)[/p][/*][*][p]Shop displays now reveal true coin counts (no more mysterious economic illusions)[/p][/*][*][p]New resolution options (3840x2160 and 2560x1440)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer retreat too early[/p][/*][*][p]Your Steam name now appears on victory screens (perfect for claiming your artifact rights)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ready to claim your reward?[/b][/p]
